author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Sprock traded to Blue Jays
desc: The Blue Jays are acquiring Ryan Sprock from Twins for Tommy Nance.
impact: Sprock was in High-A for Minnesota, hitting .297 this season with 38 RBI and 14 stolen bases.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JJ Wetherholt agrees to long-term extension with Cardinals
desc: JJ Wetherholt and the St. Louis Cardinals are in agreement on a long-term contract extension.
impact: The deal is expected to buy out multiple years of free agency for the standout rookie. Wetherholt becomes the latest rookie to land a nine-figure contract, hitting .267 this season with 13 home runs and 36 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Easton McGee designated for assignment
desc: The Brewers designated Easton McGee for assignment.
impact: McGee loses his spot on the Brewers 40-man roster with the signing of Bryse Wilson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Rom optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers optioned Drew Rom to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Rom returns to Triple-A to make room for the signing of Bryse Wilson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Nance traded to Twins
desc: The Twins are acquiring Tommy Nance from the Blue Jays.
impact: Minnesota enters Friday just one game out of the Wild Card race. Nance has posted a 3.82 ERA across 33 innings pitched this sesson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Nationals transferred RHP Jake Irvin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.
impact: Irvin recently progressed to facing live hitters. He is likely still several weeks away from making his return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Sanders optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Pirates optioned Cam Sanders to Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Sanders gets optioned for Pittsburgh to bring up a fresh arm for this weekend. He should be called back up after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Stratton optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Pirates optioned RHP Hunter Stratton to Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Stratton gets optioned for Pittsburgh to bring up a fresh arm for this weekend. He should be called back up after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Schwarber to participate in Home Run Derby
desc: Kyle Schwarber announced that he's in Monday night's Home Run Derby.
impact: Schwarber will join Bryce Harper in their home ball park. He leads all of baseball with 32 home runs this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early confirmed to be dealing with posterior elbow inflammation
desc: Connelly Early went for a second opinion that confirmed the diagnosis of posterior elbow inflammation/irritation.
impact: It is nothing more serious for Early, which is a positive sign. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyler Fedko officially optioned by Twins
desc: The Twins optioned Kyler Fedko to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Fedko returns to Triple-A with Ryan Jeffers activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Jeffers (hand) activated from IL
desc: The Twins activated Ryan Jeffers from the injured list.
impact: Jeffers rejoined the Twins on Thursday. He'll be back for the final series before the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jose Cuas optioned to Triple-A
desc: Jose Cuas was sent back to Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
impact: Cuas will clear the way for Eli Morgan to be called up and rejoin the Royals' pen. Cuas has performed mostly well since being last called up, but he's made five relief appearances in the last nine days. In that span, the 32-year-old righty has allowed just two runs while striking out nine across 6 1/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Eli Morgan recalled on Friday
desc: Eli Morgan was called up from Triple-A ahead of Friday's game against the Orioles.
impact: Morgan has struggled a bit in the majors so far this season, but he's earned his way back up with excellent work at Triple-A. In the minors this year, Morgan has posted a 1.42 ERA with 31 strikeouts across 19 innings. He's also collected three saves.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kameron Misner sent to minors
desc: Kameron Misner was optioned to Triple-A on Friday.
impact: With Vinnie Paquantino (hand) set to return to the Royals' lineup, Misner will head back to the minors. Misner has played in 18 games for the Royals this season, posting just a .500 OPS with four RBI and three steals over 44 plate appearances.
